-- One node per LibreNMS location that has GPS coordinates.
-- Anything you add/move in LibreNMS shows up here automatically.
SELECT
  CAST(l.id AS CHAR)                         AS id,
  l.location                                 AS title,
  CAST(l.lat AS DOUBLE)                      AS latitude,
  CAST(l.lng AS DOUBLE)                      AS longitude,
  COUNT(*)                                   AS switches,
  SUM(d.status = 0)                          AS down,
  COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN d.status = 0
         THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(d.sysName, ''), d.hostname) END
    ORDER BY d.hostname SEPARATOR ', '), '') AS down_devices
FROM devices d
JOIN locations l ON l.id = d.location_id
WHERE d.disabled = 0
  AND d.`ignore` = 0
  AND d.type = 'network'
  AND l.lat IS NOT NULL
  AND l.lng IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY l.id, l.location, l.lat, l.lng

-- One edge per building pair, built from LLDP/CDP neighbours in the links table.
-- Each physical link is seen from both ends, so collapse those first, then
-- roll physical links (incl. LAG members) up to building-to-building edges.
WITH seen AS (
  SELECT
    LEAST(dl.location_id, dr.location_id)    AS a,
    GREATEST(dl.location_id, dr.location_id) AS b,
    CASE WHEN k.remote_port_id IS NULL
         THEN CONCAT('L', k.local_port_id)
         ELSE CONCAT(LEAST(k.local_port_id, k.remote_port_id), '-',
                     GREATEST(k.local_port_id, k.remote_port_id)) END AS phys,
    (pl.ifOperStatus <> 'up')                AS is_down,
    pl.ifHighSpeed                           AS mbps
  FROM links k
  JOIN devices dl ON dl.device_id = k.local_device_id
  JOIN devices dr ON dr.device_id = k.remote_device_id
  JOIN ports   pl ON pl.port_id   = k.local_port_id
  JOIN locations la ON la.id = dl.location_id
  JOIN locations lb ON lb.id = dr.location_id
  WHERE k.active = 1
    AND pl.deleted = 0
    AND dl.disabled = 0 AND dl.`ignore` = 0 AND dl.type = 'network'
    AND dr.disabled = 0 AND dr.`ignore` = 0 AND dr.type = 'network'
    AND dl.location_id <> dr.location_id
    AND la.lat IS NOT NULL AND lb.lat IS NOT NULL
    -- AND pl.ifTrunk IS NOT NULL   -- uncomment to keep only 802.1Q trunk ports
),
phys AS (
  SELECT a, b, phys, MAX(is_down) AS is_down, MAX(mbps) AS mbps
  FROM seen
  GROUP BY a, b, phys
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(a, '-', b)          AS id,
  CAST(a AS CHAR)            AS source,
  CAST(b AS CHAR)            AS target,
  COUNT(*)                   AS links,
  SUM(is_down)               AS down_links,
  ROUND(SUM(mbps) / 1000, 1) AS gbps
FROM phys
GROUP BY a, b
